pli-tv-kd14:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asammukhībhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kammāni karonti
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.3: tajjaniyam pi nissayam pi pabbājaniyam pi paṭisāraṇiyam pi ukkhepaniyam pi.
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asammukhībhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kammāni karissanti
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asammukhībhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kammāni karonti
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.12: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tesaṃ moghapurisānaṃ ananulomikaṃ . . . akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā asammukhībhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kammāni karissanti
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.18: na bhikkhave asammukhībhūtānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kammaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.21: adhammavādī puggalo, adhammavādī sambahulā, adhammavādī saṃgho,
pli-tv-kd14:1.1.22: dhammavādī puggalo, dhammavādī sambahulā, dhammavādī saṃgho.
pli-tv-kd14:2.1.1: adhammavādī puggalo dhammavādiṃ puggalaṃ saññāpeti nijjhāpeti pekkheti anupekkheti dasseti anudasseti
pli-tv-kd14:2.1.2: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthusāsanaṃ imaṃ gaṇhāhi imaṃ rocehīti.
pli-tv-kd14:2.1.3: evañ ce taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati adhammena vūpasammati sammukhāvinayapaṭirūpakena.
pli-tv-kd14:2.1.6: evañ ce taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati adhammena vūpasammati sammukhāvinayapaṭirūpakena.
pli-tv-kd14:2.1.9: evañ ce taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati adhammena vūpasammati sammukhāvinayapaṭirūpakena.
pli-tv-kd14:3.1.3: evañ ce taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati dhammena vūpasammati sammukhāvinayena.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā Dabbena Mallaputtena jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.3: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ tena anuppattaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.4: n' atthi c' assa kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.5: atha kho āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evañ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.6: mayā kho jātiyā sattavassena arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.7: yaṃ kiñci sāvakena pattabbaṃ sabbaṃ mayā anuppattaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.8: n' atthi ca me kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ katassa vā paticayo.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.9: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ saṃghassa veyyāvaccaṃ kareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.10: atha kho āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:4.1.11: nūnāhaṃ saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpeyyaṃ bhattāni ca uddiseyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.1: atha kho āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.8: tassa mayhaṃ bhante etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.9: nūnāhaṃ saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpeyyaṃ bhattāni ca uddiseyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.10: icchām' ahaṃ bhante saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpetuṃ bhattāni ca uddisitun ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.12: tena hi tvaṃ Dabba saṃghassa senāsanañ ca paññāpehi bhattāni ca uddisāhīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.2.13: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto bhagavato paccassosi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañ ca bhattuddesakañ ca sammannatu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.5: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.7: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañ ca bhattuddesakañ ca sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.10: saṃgho āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ senāsanapaññāpakañ ca bhattuddesakañ ca sammannati.
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.11: yassāyasmato khamati āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa senāsanapaññāpakassa ca bhattuddesakassa ca sammuti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd14:4.3.13: sammato saṃghena āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto senāsanapaññāpako ca bhattuddesako ca.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.1: sammato ca āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto sabhāgānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.2: ye te bhikkhū suttantikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.4: ye te bhikkhū vinayadharā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.6: ye te bhikkhū dhammakathikā tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.8: ye te bhikkhū jhāyino tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.10: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḷhībahulā viharanti tesam pi ekajjhaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.11: imāya pi ime āyasmantā ratiyā acchissantīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.12: ye pi te bhikkhū vikāle āgacchanti tesam pi tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā ten' eva ālokena senāsanaṃ paññāpeti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.13: api ssu bhikkhū sañcicca vikāle āgacchanti
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.14: mayaṃ āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ passissāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.15: te āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.17: te āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.20: amhākaṃ āvuso Dabba Gijjhakūṭe senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.22: amhākaṃ āvuso Isigilipasse Kāḷasilāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.23: amhākaṃ āvuso Vebhārapasse Sattapaṇṇiguhāyaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.24: amhākaṃ āvuso Sītavane Sappasoṇḍikapabbhāre senāsanaṃ paññāpehi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.30: amhākaṃ āvuso Maddakucchismiṃ migadāye senāsanaṃ paññāpehīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.31: tesaṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā aṅguliyā jalamānāya purato-purato gacchati,
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.32: te pi ten' eva ālokena āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.33: tesaṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpeti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.34: ayaṃ mañco idaṃ pīṭhaṃ ayaṃ bhisī idaṃ bimbohanaṃ idaṃ vaccaṭṭhānaṃ idaṃ passāvaṭṭhānaṃ idaṃ pāniyaṃ idaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ ayaṃ kattaradaṇḍo idaṃ saṃghassa katikasaṇṭhānaṃ imaṃ kālaṃ pavisitabbaṃ imaṃ kālaṃ nikkhamitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.4.35: tesaṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto evaṃ senāsanaṃ paññāpetvā punad eva Veḷuvanaṃ paccāgacchati. ||4||
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.1: tena kho pana samayena Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū navakā c' eva honti appapuññā ca,
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.2: yāni saṃghassa lāmakāni senāsanāni tāni tesaṃ pāpuṇanti lāmakāni ca bhattāni.
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.3: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe manussā icchanti therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhisaṃkhārikaṃ dātuṃ
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.4: sappim pi telam pi uttaribhaṅgam pi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.7: te pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā there bhikkhū pucchanti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.8: tumhākaṃ āvuso bhattagge kiṃ ahosi, tumhākaṃ kiṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.5.10: amhākaṃ āvuso sappi ahosi, telaṃ ahosi, uttaribhaṅgaṃ ahosīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.1: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saṃghassa catukkabhattaṃ deti niccabhattaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.3: aññe odanena pucchanti aññe sūpena pucchanti aññe telena pucchanti aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchanti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.4: tena kho pana samayena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ svātanāya Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.5: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi kenacid eva karaṇīyena,
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.6: yenāyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kalyāṇabhattikaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.8: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati āyasmatā Dabbena Mallaputtena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito . . . sampahaṃsito āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.9: kassa bhante amhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.10: Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ kho gahapati bhikkhūnaṃ tumhākaṃ ghare svātanāya bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.11: atha kho kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati anattamano ahosi
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.12: kathaṃ hi nāma pāpabhikkhū amhākaṃ ghare bhuñjissantīti, gharaṃ gantvā dāsiṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.13: ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.6.14: evaṃ ayyā 'ti kho sā dāsī kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino paccassosi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.2: hiyyo kho āvuso amhākaṃ kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino bhattaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.3: sve amhākaṃ kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati saputtadāro upatiṭṭhitvā parivisissati,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.4: aññe odanena pucchissanti aññe sūpena pucchissanti aññe telena pucchissanti aññe uttaribhaṅgena pucchissantīti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.5: te ten' eva somanassena na cittarūpaṃ rattiyā supiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.6: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena kalyāṇabhattikassa gahapatino nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.7: addasā kho sā dāsī Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū dūrato 'va āgacchante,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.8: disvāna koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.10: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.11: nissaṃsayaṃ kho na tāva bhattaṃ siddhaṃ bhavissati yathā mayaṃ koṭṭhake nisīdāpeyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.12: atha kho sā dāsī kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena upagacchi
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.17: ye je sve bhattikā āgacchanti koṭṭhake āsanaṃ paññāpetvā kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.20: hiyyo kho āvuso kalyāṇabhattiko gahapati ārāmaṃ agamāsi Dabbassa Mallaputtassa santike,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.21: nissaṃsayaṃ Dabbena Mallaputtena gahapatino antare paribhinnā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.22: te ten' eva domanassena na cittarūpaṃ bhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.7.23: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā ārāmaṃ gantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake saṃghāṭipallatthikāya nisīdiṃsu tuṇhibhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā. ||7||
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.1: atha kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī yena Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.5: tatiyam pi kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.7: tatiyam pi kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū nālapiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.10: tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhagini amhe Dabbena Mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.12: sace kho tvaṃ bhagini iccheyyāsi ajj' eva bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ nāsāpeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.15: ehi tvaṃ bhagini yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.16: idaṃ bhante na channaṃ na paṭirūpaṃ, yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā,
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.20: evaṃ ayyā 'ti kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.8.21: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Mettiyā bhikkhunī bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.2: sarasi tvaṃ Dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ bhikkhunī āhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.4: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.10: na kho Dabba Dabbā evaṃ nibbeṭhenti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.11: sace tayā kataṃ katan ti vadehi,
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.13: yato 'haṃ bhante jāto nābhijānāmi supinantena pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā pag eva jāgaro 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.15: tena hi bhikkhave Mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsetha
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.17: idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.18: atha kho te bhikkhū Mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.19: atha kho Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.20: māvuso Mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsetha, na sā kiñci aparajjhati,
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.21: amhehi sā ussāhitā kupitehi anattamanehi cāvanādhippāyehīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.22: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.24: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.25: kathaṃ hi nāma Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsessantīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.26: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:4.9.27: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsentīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.1: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Dabbassa Mallaputtassa sativepullappattassa sativinayaṃ detu.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.3: tena bhikkhave Dabbena Mallaputtena saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.4: ime maṃ bhante Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsenti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.5: so 'haṃ bhante sativepullappatto saṃghaṃ sativinayaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.8: ime maṃ bhante Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsenti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.9: so 'haṃ bhante sativepullappatto tatiyam pi saṃghaṃ sativinayaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.12: ime Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsenti,
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.13: āyasmā Dabbo Mallaputto sativepullappatto saṃghaṃ sativinayaṃ yācati.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.14: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa sativepullappattassa sativinayaṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-kd14:4.10.19: saṃgho āyasmato Dabbassa Mallaputtassa sativepullappattassa sativinayaṃ deti.

pli-tv-kd14:4.11.1: pañc' imāni bhikkhave dhammikāni sativinayassa dānāni:
pli-tv-kd14:4.11.2: suddho hoti bhikkhu anāpattiko, anuvadanti ca naṃ, yācati ca, tassa saṃgho sativinayaṃ deti, dhammena samaggo.

pli-tv-kd14:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Gaggo bhikkhu ummattako hoti cittavipariyāsakato,
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.2: tena ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.3: bhikkhū Gaggaṃ bhikkhuṃ ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena ajjhāciṇṇena āpattiyā codenti
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.6: ahaṃ kho āvuso ummattako ahosiṃ cittavipariyāsakato,
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.7: tena me ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ bhāsitaparikantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.10: evam pi naṃ vuccamānā codent' eva
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.12: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū Gaggaṃ bhikkhuṃ ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena ajjhāciṇṇena āpattiyā codessanti
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.22: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:5.1.27: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Gaggassa bhikkhuno amūḷhassa amūḷhavinayaṃ detu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.2: tena bhikkhave Gaggena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.4: tena me ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ bhāsitaparikantaṃ, taṃ
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.5: maṃ bhikkhū ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena ajjhāciṇṇenāapattiyā codenti
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.8: ahaṃ kho āvuso ummattako ahosiṃ cittavipariyāsakato,
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.9: tena me ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ bhāsitaparikantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.12: evam pi maṃ vuccamānā codent' eva
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.14: so 'haṃ bhante amūḷho saṃghaṃ amūḷhavinayaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd14:5.2.27: tatiyam pi bhante saṃghaṃ amūḷhavinayaṃ yācāmīti.

pli-tv-kd14:5.2.38: evam pi naṃ vuccamānā codent' eva

pli-tv-kd14:6.1.1: tīṇīmāni bhikkhave adhammikāni amūḷhavinayassa dānāni, tīṇi dhammikāni.
pli-tv-kd14:6.1.3: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpanno hoti,

pli-tv-kd14:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū apaṭiññāya bhikkhūnaṃ kammāni karonti
pli-tv-kd14:7.1.2: tajjaniyam pi nissayam pi pabbājaniyam pi paṭisāraṇiyam pi ukkhepaniyam pi.
pli-tv-kd14:7.1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:7.1.4: kathañ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū apaṭiññāya bhikkhūnaṃ kammāni karissanti
pli-tv-kd14:7.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:7.1.11: na bhikkhave apaṭiññāya bhikkhūnaṃ kammaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave adhammikaṃ hoti paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ evaṃ dhammikaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.2: kathañ ca bhikkhave adhammikaṃ hoti paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.4: tam enaṃ codeti saṃgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.7: na kho ahaṃ āvuso pārājikaṃ ajjhāpanno, saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.14: na kho ahaṃ āvuso pārājikaṃ ajjhāpanno, thullaccayaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.27: tam enaṃ codeti saṃgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.30: na kho ahaṃ āvuso dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpanno, pārājikaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti,
pli-tv-kd14:8.1.37: na kho ahaṃ āvuso dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpanno, saṃghādisesaṃ --la--
pli-tv-kd14:8.2.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave adhammikaṃ hoti paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd14:8.2.2: kathañ ca bhikkhave dhammikaṃ hoti paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:8.2.4: tam enaṃ codeti saṃgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā
pli-tv-kd14:8.2.22: evaṃ kho bhikkhave dhammikaṃ hoti paṭiññātakaraṇan ti. ||2||8||
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saṃghamajjhe bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti na sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ yebhuyyasikāya vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.4: pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu salākagāhāpako sammannitabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.5: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, gahitāgahitañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.7: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo, yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.9: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ salākagāhāpakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd14:9.1.13: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno salākagāhāpakassa sammuti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd14:10.1.1: dasa yime bhikkhave adhammikā salākagāhā, dasa dhammikā.
pli-tv-kd14:10.1.3: oramattakañ ca adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, na ca gatigataṃ hoti, na ca saritasāritaṃ hoti, jānāti adhammavādī bahutarā 'ti, app eva nāma adhammavādī bahutarā assū 'ti, jānāti saṃgho bhijjissatīti, app eva nāma saṃgho bhijjeyyā 'ti, adhammena gaṇhanti, vaggā gaṇhanti, na ca yathādiṭṭhiyā gaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd14:10.2.2: na ca oramattakaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, gatigatañ ca hoti, saritasāritañ ca hoti, jānāti dhammavādī bahutarā 'ti, app eva nāma dhammavādī bahutarā assū 'ti, jānāti saṃgho na bhijjissatīti, app eva nāma saṃgho na bhijjeyyā 'ti, dhammena gaṇhanti, samaggā gaṇhanti, yathādiṭṭhiyā ca gaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd14:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Uvāḷo bhikkhu saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno avajānitvā paṭijānāti paṭijānitvā avajānāti aññena aññaṃ paṭicarati sampajānamusā bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd14:11.1.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:11.1.3: kathañ hi nāma Uvāḷo bhikkhu saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno avajānitvā paṭijānissati paṭijānitvā avajānissati aññena aññaṃ paṭicarissati sampajānamusā bhāsissatīti.
pli-tv-kd14:11.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:11.1.9: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Uvāḷassa bhikkhuno tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ karotu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd14:11.2.2: paṭhamaṃ Uvāḷo bhikkhu codetabbo, codetvā sāretabbo, sāretvā āpattiṃ ropetabbo, āpattiṃ ropetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:11.2.4: ayaṃ Uvāḷo bhikkhu saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno avajānitvā paṭijānāti . . . sampajānamusā bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd14:11.2.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho Uvāḷassa bhikkhuno tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd14:12.1.1: pañc' imāni bhikkhave dhammikāni tassapāpiyyasikākammassa karaṇāni:
pli-tv-kd14:12.1.2: asuci ca hoti, alajjī ca, sānuvādo ca, tassa saṃgho tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ karoti, dhammena samaggo.
pli-tv-kd14:12.1.3: imāni kho bhikkhave pañca dhammikāni tassapāpiyyasikākammassa karaṇāni. ||1||
pli-tv-kd14:12.2.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgataṃ tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ adhammakammañ ca hoti avinayakammañ ca duvūpasantañ ca:
pli-tv-kd14:12.2.2.1: asammukhā kataṃ hoti, apaṭipucchā kataṃ hoti, apaṭiññāya kataṃ hoti; --la--
pli-tv-kd14:12.2.3: adhammena kataṃ hoti, vaggena kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:12.2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ adhammakammañ ca hoti avinayakammañ ca duvūpasantañ ca.
pli-tv-kd14:12.3.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgataṃ tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ dhammakammañ ca hoti vinayakammañ ca suvūpasantañ ca:
pli-tv-kd14:12.3.2.1: sammukhā kataṃ hoti, paṭipucchā kataṃ hoti, paṭiññāya kataṃ hoti; --la--
pli-tv-kd14:12.3.3: dhammena kataṃ hoti, samaggena kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:12.3.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ dhammakammañ ca hoti vinayakammañ ca suvūpasantañ ca. ||2||
pli-tv-kd14:12.4.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd14:12.4.17: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ kareyya. ||3||
pli-tv-kd14:12.6.1: atha kho saṃgho Uvāḷassa bhikkhuno tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ akāsi. ||5||12||
pli-tv-kd14:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ kalahajātānaṃ vivādāpannānaṃ viharataṃ bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:13.1.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd14:13.1.4: sace mayaṃ imāhi āpattīhi aññamaññaṃ kāreyyāma siyāpi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vālattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyya.
pli-tv-kd14:13.1.5: kathaṃ nu kho amhehi paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd14:13.1.7: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ bhaṇḍanajātānaṃ . . . ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:13.1.10: saṃvatteyyā 'ti, anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇavatthārakena vūpasametuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd14:13.2.2: sabbeh' eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:13.2.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇavatthārakena vūpasameyya ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:13.2.7: ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena sako pakkho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:13.2.11: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ ahaṃ yā c' eva āyasmantānaṃ āpatti yā ca attano āpatti āyasmantānañ c' eva atthāya attano ca atthāya saṃghamajjhe tiṇavatthārakena deseyyaṃ ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:13.2.12: athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena sako pakkho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:13.3.1: ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:13.3.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ yā c' eva imesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ āpatti yā ca attano āpatti imesañ c' eva āyasmantānaṃ atthāya attano ca atthāya saṃghamajjhe tiṇavatthārakena deseyyaṃ ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:13.3.10: ahaṃ yā c' eva imesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ . . . tiṇavatthārakena desemi ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:13.3.11: yassāyasmato khamati amhākaṃ imāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ saṃghamajjhe tiṇavatthārakena desanā ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd14:13.3.13: desitā amhākaṃ imā āpattiyo saṃghamajjhe tiṇavatthārakena ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:13.3.15: athāparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:13.4.1: evañ ca pana bhikkhave te bhikkhū tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhitā honti ṭhapetvā thūlavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ ṭhapetvā diṭṭhāvikammaṃ ṭhapetvā ye na tattha hontīti. ||4||13||
pli-tv-kd14:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū pi bhikkhūhi vivadanti bhikkhuniyo pi bhikkhūhi vivadanti Channo pi bhikkhu bhikkhunīnaṃ anupakhajja bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ vivadati bhikkhunīnaṃ pakkhaṃ gāheti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.1.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd14:14.1.3: kathañ hi nāma Channo bhikkhu bhikkhunīnaṃ anupakhajja bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ vivadissati bhikkhunīnaṃ pakkhaṃ gāhessatīti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.2.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.2.4: dhammo 'ti vā adhammo 'ti vā vinayo 'ti vā avinayo 'ti vā bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenā 'ti vā abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenā 'ti vā āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenā 'ti vā anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenā 'ti vā paññattaṃ tathāgatenā 'ti vā apaññattaṃ tathāgatenā 'ti vā āpattīti vā anāpattīti vā lahukā āpattīti vā garukā āpattīti vā sāvasesā āpattīti vā anavasesā āpattīti vā duṭṭhullā āpattīti vā aduṭṭhullā āpattīti vā.
pli-tv-kd14:14.2.5: yaṃ tattha bhaṇḍanaṃ kalaho viggaho vivādo nānāvādo aññathāvādo vipaccatāya vohāro medhakaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:14.2.8: idha bhikkhave bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ anuvadanti sīlavipattiyā vā ācāravipattiyā vā diṭṭhivipattiyā vā ājīvavipattiyā vā.

pli-tv-kd14:14.3.9: na paripūrakārī so saṃghe vivā daṃ janeti,

pli-tv-kd14:14.3.13: evam etassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.3.14: evam etassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavo hoti.

pli-tv-kd14:14.3.16: issukī hoti maccharī, saṭho hoti māyāvī, pāpiccho hoti micchādiṭṭhi, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānagāhī duppaṭinissaggī.
pli-tv-kd14:14.3.17: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānagāhī duppaṭinissaggī so satthari pi agāravo viharati appatisso . . .
pli-tv-kd14:14.3.25: evam etassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavo hoti.

pli-tv-kd14:14.9.2: anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ siyā kusalaṃ siyā akusalaṃ siyā abyākataṃ.

pli-tv-kd14:14.10.5: yaṃ jānanto sañjānanto cecca abhivitaritvā vītikkamo,
pli-tv-kd14:14.10.8: yaṃ ajānanto asañjānanto acecca anabhivitaritvā vītikkamo,

pli-tv-kd14:14.12.1: vivādo vivādādhikaraṇaṃ, vivādo no adhikaraṇaṃ, adhikaraṇaṃ no vivādo, adhikaraṇañ c' eva vivādo ca.
pli-tv-kd14:14.12.2: siyā vivādo vivādādhikaraṇaṃ, siyā vivādo no adhikaraṇaṃ, siyā adhikaraṇaṃ no vivādo, siyā adhikaraṇañ c' eva vivādo ca.

pli-tv-kd14:14.15.4: yā saṃghassa kiccayatā karaṇīyatā apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:14.15.12: tattha katamaṃ adhikaraṇañ c' eva kiccañ ca.
pli-tv-kd14:14.15.13: kiccādhikaraṇaṃ adhikaraṇañ c' eva kiccañ ca. ||15||
pli-tv-kd14:14.16.3: siyā vivādādhikaraṇaṃ ekaṃ samathaṃ anāgamma yebhuyyasikaṃ ekena samathena sammeyya
pli-tv-kd14:14.16.9: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.16.15: yāvatikā bhikkhū kammappattā te āgatā honti, chandārahānaṃ chando āhaṭo hoti, sammukhībhūtā na paṭikkosanti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.16.18: yena dhammena yena vinayena yena satthusāsanena taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati
pli-tv-kd14:14.16.21: yo ca vivadati yena ca vivadati ubho attapaccatthikā sammukhībhūtā honti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.16.23: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:14.17.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū na sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tasmiṃ āvā se vūpasametuṃ tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi yasmiṃ āvāse bahutarā bhikkhū so āvāso gantabbo.
pli-tv-kd14:14.17.2: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū taṃ āvāsaṃ gacchantā antarā magge sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū taṃ āvāsaṃ gacchantā antarā magge na sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā āvāsikā bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.2: idaṃ kho āvuso adhikaraṇaṃ evaṃ jātaṃ evaṃ samuppannaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.3: sādh' āyasmantā imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamentu dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena yatha yidaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ suvūpasantaṃ assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.4: sace bhikkhave āvāsikā bhikkhū vuḍḍhatarā honti āgantukā bhikkhū navakatarā tehi bhikkhave āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi āgantukā bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.5: iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ ekamantaṃ hotha yāva mayaṃ mantemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.6: sace pana bhikkhave āvāsikā bhikkhū navakatarā honti āgantukā bhikkhū vuḍḍhatarā tehi bhikkhave āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi āgantukā bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.7: tena hi tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ idh' eva hotha yāva mayaṃ mantemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.8: sace bhikkhave āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mantayamānānaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.9: na mayaṃ sakkoma imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanenā 'ti, na taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ paṭicchitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.10: sace pana bhikkhave āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mantayamānānaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.11: sakkoma mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanenā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.12: tehi bhikkhave āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi āgantukā bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.13: sace tumhe āyasmanto amhākaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ yathājātaṃ yathāsamuppannaṃ ārocessatha yathā ca mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamessāma dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena tathā vūpasantaṃ bhavissati,
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.15: no ce tumhe āyasmanto amhākaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ yathājātaṃ yathāsamuppannaṃ ārocessatha yathā ca . . . bhavissati, na mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ paṭicchissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.16: evaṃ supariggahitaṃ kho bhikkhave katvā āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ paṭicchitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.17: tehi bhikkhave āgantukehi bhikkhūhi āvāsikā bhikkhū evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.18: yathājātaṃ yathāsamuppannaṃ mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ āyasmantānaṃ ārocessāma.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.19: sace āyasmantā sakkonti ettakena vā antarena imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena tathā suvūpasantaṃ bhavissati
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.20: evaṃ mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ āyasmantānaṃ niyyādessāma,
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.21: no ce āyasmantā sakkonti ettakena . . . tathā na suvūpasantaṃ bhavissati na mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ āyasmantānaṃ niyyādessāma,
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.22: mayam eva imassa adhikaraṇassa sāmino bhavissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.23: evaṃ supariggahitaṃ kho bhikkhave katvā āgantukehi bhikkhūhi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ niyyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.18.24: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ, idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni c' eva bhassāni jāyanti na c' ekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati, anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.2: dasah' aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu ubbāhikāya sammannitabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.3: sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācārasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.4: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sa vyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūp' assa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.5: ubhayāni kho pan' assa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttato anuvyañjanaso,
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.6: vinaye kho pana cheko hoti asaṃhīro,
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.7: paṭibalo hoti ubho attapaccatthike saññāpetuṃ nijjhāpetuṃ pekkhetuṃ passituṃ pasādetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:14.19.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi dasah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ ubbāhikāya sammannituṃ. ||19||
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.2: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo, yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.4: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anaggāni c' eva bhassāni jāyanti na c' ekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhuṃ sammanneyya ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.9: saṃgho itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhuṃ sammannati ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.10: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa ca itthannāmassa ca bhikkhuno sammuti ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd14:14.20.12: sammato saṃghena itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca bhikkhu ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.21.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasametuṃ idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.21.6: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. ||21||
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne tatr' assa bhikkhu dhammakathiko, tassa n' eva suttaṃ āgataṃ hoti no suttavibhaṅgo, so atthaṃ asallakkhento vyañjanacchāyāya atthaṃ paṭibāhati, vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.4: imassa n' eva suttaṃ āgataṃ no suttavibhaṅgo,
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.5: so atthaṃ asallakkhento vyañjanacchāyāya atthaṃ paṭibāhati.
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.6: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā avasesā imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.7: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.22.12: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. ||22||
pli-tv-kd14:14.23.1: tehi ce bhikkhave bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne tatr' assa bhikkhu dhammakathiko, tassa suttañ hi kho āgataṃ hoti no suttavibhaṅgo, so atthaṃ asallakkhento vyañjanacchāyāya atthaṃ paṭibāhati, vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.23.4: imassa suttaṃ hi kho āgataṃ no suttavibhaṅgo,
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.1: te ce bhikkhave bhikkhū na sakkonti taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasametuṃ, tehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ saṃghassa niyyādetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.2: na mayaṃ bhante sakkoma imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasametuṃ, saṃgho 'va imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ yebhuyyasikāya vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.18: yathā bahutarā bhikkhū dhammavādino vadenti tathā taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.34: yā yebhuyyasikāya kammassa kiriyā karaṇaṃ upagamanaṃ ajjhupagamanaṃ adhivāsanā apaṭikkosanā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.24.36: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyā evaṃ jātaṃ evaṃ samuppannaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.4: assosuṃ kho amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulā therā viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā paṇḍitā viyattā medhāvino lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.5: te ce therā imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena evam idaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ suvūpasantaṃ assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.6: atha kho te bhikkhū taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā te there etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.7: idaṃ bhante adhikaraṇaṃ evaṃ jātaṃ evaṃ samuppannaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.8: sādhu bhante therā imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamentu dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena yatha yidaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ suvūpasantaṃ assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.10: yathā Sāvatthiyā saṃghena adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ tathā suvūpasantan ti
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.13: asantuṭṭhā Sāvatthiyā saṃghassa adhikaraṇavūpasamanena asantuṭṭhā sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ adhikaraṇavūpasamanena.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.14: assosuṃ kho amukasmiṃ kira āvāse tayo therā viharanti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.16: eko thero viharati bahussuto āgatāgamo . . . sikkhākāmo,
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.17: so ce thero imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyya dhammena . . . assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.18: atha kho te bhikkhū taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā taṃ theraṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.20: sādhu bhante thero imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametu . . . assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.22: yathā Sāvatthiyā saṃghena adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ yathā sambahulehi therehi adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ yathā tīhi therehi adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ yathā dvīhi therehi adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamitaṃ tathā suvūpasantan ti
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.24: atha kho te bhikkhū asantuṭṭhā Sāvatthiyā saṃghassa adhikaraṇavūpasamanena asantuṭṭhā sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ . . . tiṇṇaṃ therānaṃ . . . dvinnaṃ therānaṃ . . . ekassa therassa adhikaraṇavūpasamanena yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.25.25: nihataṃ etaṃ bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ santaṃ vūpasantaṃ suvūpasantan ti. ||25||
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.1: anujānāmi bhikkhave tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññattiyā tayo salākagāhe
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.3: kathañ ca bhikkhave gūḷhako salākagāho hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.4: tena salākagāhāpakena bhikkhunā salākāyo vaṇṇāvaṇṇāyo katvā ekameko bhikkhu upasaṃkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.5: ayaṃ evaṃvādissa salākā ayaṃ evaṃvādissa salākā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.13: evaṃ kho bhikkhave gūḷhako salākagāho hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.14: kathañ ca bhikkhave sakaṇṇajappako salākagāho hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.15: tena salākagāhāpakena bhikkhunā ekamekassa bhikkhuno upakaṇṇake ārocetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.16: ayaṃ evaṃvādissa salākā ayaṃ evaṃvādissa salākā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.24: evaṃ kho bhikkhave sakaṇṇajappako salākagāho hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.25: kathañ ca bhikkhave vivaṭako salākagāho hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.27: dhammavādī bahutarā 'ti vissatthen' eva vivaṭena gāhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd14:14.26.28: evaṃ kho bhikkhave vivaṭako salākagāho hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.3: sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyyasikāya ca.
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.10: idha bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsenti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.11: tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sativepullappattassa sativinayo dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.13: tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.15: maṃ bhante bhikkhū amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsenti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.16: so 'haṃ bhante sativepullappatto saṃghaṃ sativinayaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.21: bhikkhū itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsenti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.41: yo ca anuvadati yañ ca anuvadati ubho sammukhībhūtā honti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.44: yā sativinayassa kammassa kiriyā karaṇaṃ upagamanaṃ ajjhupagamanaṃ adhivāsanā apaṭikkosanā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.27.46: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.8: tena ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ hoti bhāsitaparikantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.9: taṃ bhikkhū ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena ajjhāciṇṇena āpattiyā codenti
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.12: ahaṃ kho āvuso ummattako ahosiṃ cittavipariyāsakato,
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.13: tena me ummattakena cittavipariyāsakatena bahuṃ assāmaṇakaṃ ajjhāciṇṇaṃ bhāsitaparikantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.16: evam pi naṃ vuccamānā codent' eva
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.18: tassa kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno amūḷhassa amūḷhavinayo dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.20: tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā --la--
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.38: itthannāmo, itthannāmassa; instead of bhikkhū Gaggaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:14.28.80: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.7: idha bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ saṃghamajjhe garukāya āpattiyā codeti
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.8: sarat' āyasmā evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.10: na kho ahaṃ āvuso sarāmi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.12: iṅghāyasmā sādhukam eva jānāhi yadi sarasi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.14: na kho ahaṃ āvuso sarāmi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.15: sarāmi ca kho ahaṃ āvuso evarūpiṃ appamattikaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.17: iṅghāyasmā sādhukam eva jānāhi yadi sarasi . . . vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.19: imaṃ hi nāmāhaṃ āvuso appamattikaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā apuṭṭho paṭijānissāmi,
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.20: kiṃ panāhaṃ evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā puṭṭho na paṭijānissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.22: imaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ āvuso appamattikaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā apuṭṭho na paṭijānissasi,
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.23: kim pana tvaṃ evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā apuṭṭho paṭijānissasi.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.24: iṅghāyasmā sādhukam eva jānāhi yadi sarasi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.26: sarāmi kho ahaṃ āvuso evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.27: davā me etaṃ vuttaṃ, ravā me etaṃ vuttaṃ
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.28: nāhan taṃ sarāmi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.29: tassa kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno tassapāpiyyasikākammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.51: yā tassapāpiyyasikāya kammassa kiriyā karaṇaṃ upagamanaṃ ajjhupagamanaṃ adhivāsanā apaṭikkosanā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.29.53: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ kārako ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.30.3: sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.
pli-tv-kd14:14.30.9: idha bhikkhu lahukaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.30.10: tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd14:14.30.23: yo ca deseti yassa ca deseti ubho sammukhībhūtā honti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.30.26: yā paṭiññātakaraṇassa kammassa kiriyā karaṇaṃ upagamanaṃ ajjhupagamanaṃ adhivāsanā apaṭikkosanā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.30.28: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ paṭiggāhako ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ. ||30||
pli-tv-kd14:14.31.1: evañ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.31.2: no ce labhetha tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.31.5: vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:
pli-tv-kd14:14.31.7: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu āpattiṃ sarati vivarati uttānīkaroti deseti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.31.8: yad' āyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ ahaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno āpattiṃ paṭigaṇheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.32.1: evañ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.32.2: no ce labhetha tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā . . . evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd14:14.32.7: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu āpattiṃ sarati vivarati uttānīkaroti deseti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.32.8: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno āpattiṃ paṭigaṇheyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd14:14.32.18: evaṃ vūpasantañ ce bhikkhave adhikaraṇaṃ paṭiggāhako ukkoṭeti, ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd14:14.33.49: yāvatikā bhikkhū kammappattā te āgatā honti, chandārahānaṃ chando āhaṭo hoti, sammukhībhūtā na paṭikkosanti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.33.52: yena dhammena yena vinayena yena satthu sāsanena taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati,
pli-tv-kd14:14.33.55: yo ca deseti yassa ca deseti ubho sammukhībhūtā honti,
pli-tv-kd14:14.33.58: yā tiṇavatthārakassa kammassa kiriyā karaṇaṃ upagamanaṃ ajjhupagamanaṃ adhivāsanā apaṭikkosanā,
pli-tv-kd14:14.33.60: evaṃ vūpasantaṃ ce bhikkhave . . . ukkoṭanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
